comparison.objective: Commission a damper versus thread shock cord through a spring cord lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine rigid rotational adjustment and locking versus sustained button depression with deformable-cord feeding through a passage.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe dynamic stops and witness-tested setting retention versus required cord lengths on both sides, continuous button actuation during threading, spring retention, and release.
comparison.reason: A spring-loaded lock is not enough to establish overlap; the physical skills and success evidence differ. Candidate thresholds remain incomplete.
